quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road ahead.
You can pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must follow all rules on regulatory signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You see these signs at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of curves ahead. Slow down.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an octagonal sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road conditions ahead and are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. Red means stop. Yellow means slow down and prepare to stop. Green means go.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop. Then look in all directions to make sure no traffic is coming before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where pedestrians cross the road. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you cannot enter from your current direction. The road is one-way or this is an expressway ramp. You must not go this way.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: School crossing signs are five-sided. They warn you that you are near a school. Look for children and be prepared to stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully in wet weather.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake problems or accidents.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. You do not have to stop completely, but you must be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Be alert and ready to stop.

questions.question: What message appears on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs mark a no passing zone. You cannot pass other vehicles in this area. It is unsafe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When conditions are bad, slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through the middle means something is not allowed. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What do blue traffic signs tell you about?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services nearby.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Certain turns are only allowed from certain lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. This lane is only for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; a curving road is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane will need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black signs warn drivers about hazards. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let any other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone begins after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph through the upcoming curve.
Slow to 35 mph or less before entering the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or less before entering the curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. Speed advisory signs tell you the safe speed to use in that area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines can be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops instead of or with turn signals. An arm extended straight to the left means you will turn left or change lanes left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop if necessary before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you that you are near or entering a school zone. Watch for children and obey the speed limit.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Be alert and cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield for left turn on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield for left turn on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns of roadwork coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in work zones.

questions.question: This shape and color is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down when you see a yield sign and stop if necessary. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is roadwork ahead; detour to the right.
Slow down; the road ahead curves sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road ahead curves sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead changes direction sharply. Slow down as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells drivers that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that vehicles turning left do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for what is ahead. This sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is always a yield sign. When you see it, be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop if a train is coming.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and be ready to stop if they are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a crossroad is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is cleaning up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that workers may be on or very close to the road. Drive with extra care through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is coming up. Drivers should be careful where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that they are leaving a divided road and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive toward it.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that other vehicles may be merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch for deer, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps you find cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about conditions on or near the road. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Must stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign shows you are approaching a railroad crossing. Look, listen, slow down, and prepare to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. These include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Several chevron signs may appear along the curve.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a yellow-green background. These signs warn about upcoming conditions, including curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give drivers extra space to merge safely into traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give drivers extra space to merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means you cannot do the action shown. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing where the road dips low. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic will be merging onto the road from the right. Be ready to make room.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or for any other reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway ahead. Turn around and use a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign gives you advance notice that bicycles may be on or crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
This lane is for buses and cars with two or more people.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that these parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will change direction ahead.

questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign means "stop."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns of low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign tells drivers to stop and yield right-of-way at an intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A traffic control device is ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance from the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either stay in your lane or exit the freeway.
Can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel means the lane ends at the exit ramp. If you stay in that lane, you must exit the highway. You can change lanes before the sign to continue through the interchange.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians who are in or about to enter a crosswalk. Watch carefully for pedestrians when you drive through intersections or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down and enter at a low speed. Yield to cars already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for exiting a highway. For example, if it shows 30 mph, that is the safe exit speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
